footguns.name: 01-side-effect-before-interrupt
footguns.reintroduces: The publish call moves into the approval node, before interrupt(). The node re-runs from the top on resume, so it sends again; and it already sent before anyone answered.

footguns.name: 02-no-dispatch-ledger
footguns.reintroduces: The dispatch node sends without the claim-then-send ledger. A retry after a crash sends again.

footguns.name: 03-untyped-handoff
footguns.reintroduces: The supervisor trusts the worker's dict and routes on a string; a destination it does not know means 'finished'. A malformed handoff ends the run as a success with nothing dispatched.

footguns.name: 04-no-loop-budget
footguns.reintroduces: No per-thread handoff budget. Two workers that keep asking each other for more run until LangGraph's recursion_limit stops them.

footguns.name: 05-approval-not-bound
footguns.reintroduces: The approval is a bare decision, not bound to the hash of the draft. A draft edited after the reviewer saw it, or an approval with no hash at all, is dispatched.

footguns.name: 06-in-memory-checkpointer
footguns.reintroduces: Checkpoints live in process memory. A restart has nothing to resume: the thread, and the researcher's finished work, are gone.
